what: The folder set Docs Librarian creates during setup, in the storage the owner picks at message 1. Fetched at setup by docs-librarian-getting-started.

rules: Ask the owner before creating anything.
Never overwrite or rename a folder that is already there; ask first.
Files stay in the owner's own storage. The index only holds the details and the link.
Say in one line what was created and where.
